tasks.title: 30-day TTL sweep for terminal live-admission work items
tasks.objective: Add a batched, advisory-locked DELETE of terminal live-admission rows older than 30 days (coalesce(ended_at, updated_at)), expose it through the live-turns port, and run it from the scheduler's maintenance loop behind a 6-hour per-process cadence guard as an optional injected dep so existing fixtures stay untouched.
acceptance_criteria: deleteExpiredTerminalLiveAdmissionWorkItems deletes ONLY rows with state in ('completed','failed','canceled') and age older than the cutoff; old non-terminal rows and recent terminal rows survive — proven by an integration test seeding all cases
the delete is batched (bounded per-transaction) and serialized across processes via pg_advisory_xact_lock
the sweep runs from syncAllJobs at most once per 6h per process (unit test on the cadence guard); the 60s maintenance tick alone never triggers repeated sweeps
the scheduler dep is optional with a real default in scheduler.ts; the 26 existing task-scheduler-pgboss fixtures pass unmodified
retention is the fixed constant 30 days per decision 0103 — no new config surface
the existing capacity test 'replays duplicates at capacity and frees capacity only for terminal rows' passes unmodified

required_tests.id: PgBossSchedulerEngine > sweeps terminal live-admission work items at most once per interval
required_tests.command: VITEST_JUNIT=1 FORGE_TEST_ID={id} npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts {path} --outputFile {report}
